name: nexova
description: Nexova: paste social links or products, get a live e-commerce website. Claude-powered engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexova/engine && npm run build -w @nexova/server && npm run build -w @nexova/web
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start -w @nexova/server
scripts.build:cloud: npm run build -w @nexova/engine && npm run build -w @nexova/web && npm run build:cloud -w @nexova/server
scripts.dev:cloud: npm run build -w @nexova/engine && npm run build -w @nexova/web && npm run dev:cloud -w @nexova/server
